source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#9
statement_en:
Let \(F(s,x):\\mathbb{R}^2\	o\\mathbb{R}\) be real analytic in some neighborhood \(U\) of \((s^{*},x_k(0))\), and suppose
\\[
F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,\\quad F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\
eq 0.
\\]
Then there exist a neighborhood \(V\) of \(s^{*}\) and a neighborhood \(W\) of \(x_k(0)\) such that on \(V\) the equation \(F(s,x)=0\) has exactly one solution branch
\\[
x(s):V\	o W,
\\]
and \(x(s)\) is real analytic, namely
\\[
x(s)=\\sum_{i\\ge 0} a_i s^i,\\quad \\forall s\\in V.
\\]
callout_body: 设$F(s,x):\mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}$在$(s^{*},x_k(0))$的某个邻域$U$内满足$F$是一个实数解析函数并且$$F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\neq 0$$那么存在一个$s^{*}$的邻域$V$以及$x_k(0)$的邻域$W$使得在$V$上方程$F(s,x)=0$有且仅有一个解分支：$$x(s):V\to W$$并且$x(s)$是一个实解析函数，即$$x(s)=\sum_{i\geq 0}a_i s^i,\forall s\in V$$
